cs.t: I bought a set of carbon steel pans and my cast iron ones fell into complete disuse. Especially carbon steel crepes pans ( https://www.debuyer.com/en/poele-a-crepes-mineral-b-1472.htm... ) are completely unbeatable. I have two of them and I can feed a small crowd of family and friends faster than they can eat. Nothing sticks if you take proper care. The best thing, they are dirt cheap.
cs.th: Ask HN: Favorite purchases of last two years?
